comparison.reason: Previous is a Windows x64 six-case reflection direct-control run; latest is macOS arm64, the full 483-case suite, and different measurement settings. No cross-run performance attribution.
comparison.previous_summary_encoding: UTF-8 JSON; ensure_ascii=False; sorted keys; separators=(',', ':'); no trailing newline

limitations: macOS arm64 / Apple M1 Pro / Release only; not comparable to the historical Windows x64 results.
Complete workloads use optimized reloadable JIT; native free-call optimized JIT is closed-program. Native class closed and reloadable modes are reported separately.
Compilation, input preparation and warm-up are excluded from steady timing; ordinary GC and checksum checks remain timed.
C++ reflection is a fixed-receiver, fixed-signature hand-registered reference without the full Vela GC/reload/dynamic argument contract.
Direct reflection controls allow inlining and redundant-access elimination. Per-operation numbers amortize a 128-operation batch and are not individual memory-access latency.
No samples discarded and no entry, loop or control overhead subtracted; high-variation cases remain in the aggregate.

targeted_confirmation.identity: Additional measurements of high-variation reflection method lookup and matching direct controls; full-suite seven-repetition aggregates above remain unchanged
